title: "OpenFOAM Learning Resources"
description: "A curated list of external tutorials, courses and documentation for learning OpenFOAM."
categories: [OpenFOAM, learning resources]

This page collects external material that the group has found useful for learning OpenFOAM. Each
entry says what it covers and, where it matters, which OpenFOAM version it was written for. Material
written for one version often needs small changes to work with the other (see the
[OpenFOAM section overview](index.qmd) for the difference between openfoam.org and openfoam.com).

To suggest a resource, add an entry under the most suitable heading in a pull request. Link to the
original source rather than adding a copy of the file to this repository.

## Official documentation

- [OpenFOAM User Guide (openfoam.org)](https://doc.cfd.direct/openfoam/user-guide/): the user
  guide for the OpenFOAM Foundation version, maintained by CFD Direct. Covers case structure, meshing,
  running applications and post-processing.
- [OpenFOAM documentation (openfoam.com)](https://www.openfoam.com/documentation/overview): the
  documentation hub for the ESI-OpenCFD version, including the user guide, tutorial guide and API
  reference.

## Courses and tutorial collections

- [CFD with OpenSource Software (Chalmers University of Technology)](https://www.tfd.chalmers.se/~hani/kurser/OS_CFD/):
  a course taught by Håkan Nilsson. Its page lists lecture notes and years of peer-reviewed
  student reports (organized by year), covering a wide range of OpenFOAM topics, from basic use to
  implementing new solvers and boundary conditions. Check which version each report was written for.

## Development and debugging

- [Using Visual Studio Code for debugging in OpenFOAM](https://www.tfd.chalmers.se/~hani/kurser/OS_CFD_2025/additionalMaterial/VSCodeDebuggingOpenFOAM.pdf)
  (Fjällborg and Salehi, CFD with OpenSource Software, Chalmers): shows how to set up VS Code with
  gdb so you can step through OpenFOAM source code with breakpoints and inspect variables, including
  debugging on a remote cluster over SSH. Written for openfoam.com v2506.
